ops.oldText: Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
ops.newText: On expiry or termination of this Agreement or an Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance (including export and migration support) for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates, and shall not delete Customer Data except in accordance with Sections 11.2 and 11.3.

input.comment: [Playbook] We replaced the immediate cut-off and deletion language with up to six months of transition assistance at your then-current rates, since our playbook requires an orderly exit and this drafting also contradicted the data-return and certified-deletion mechanics in 11.2 and 11.3. We can work with 90 days of assistance if that is easier operationally.
input.summary: Replace immediate-deletion/no-assistance clause with six-month transition assistance at then-current rates, subject to 11.2/11.3 return and deletion.
